summary: Stark Focus Group filed an 8-K/A amending its July 1, 2026 report on a change-of-control stock purchase agreement dated June 9, 2026. MJG Polo LLC acquired 8,300,000 shares, or roughly 83.43% of Stark's common stock, from Compass North Holdings Limited for $355,000, closing June 25, 2026; this implies about $0.0428 per share. Prior sole officer Can Zhi Fen resigned June 16, 2026, with David I. Rosenberg named Chairman and John Lipman CEO, CFO and director, effective at closing. Stark now plans to develop, own and operate AI data centers globally, a pivot from apparel wholesale.
